howToPlay.title: How to Play
howToPlay.step1Desc: Add 3-12 players and choose each player's language.
howToPlay.step2Desc: Pick a region and adjust game settings like timer and categories.
howToPlay.step3Desc: Pass the phone around. Each player taps to secretly see their word.
howToPlay.step4Desc: Citizens see the secret word. Imposters only see 'Imposter' (with an optional clue).
howToPlay.step5Desc: Ask questions! Citizens try to find the Imposter. Imposters try to blend in.
howToPlay.step6Desc: Vote on who you think the Imposter is. The majority rules!
howToPlay.step7Desc: Find out if the Imposter was caught or escaped!
